def resolve_street(
        self,
        token: str,
        district_code: str | None = None,
        province_code: str | None = None,
        has_street_keyword: bool = False,
    ) -> tuple[str, float, AbbrCategory] | None:
        """Resolve an abbreviation token using contextual administrative constraints."""
        norm_token = normalize_ascii(token)
        if not norm_token:
            return None

        stripped_token = _strip_street_keyword_prefix(norm_token)
        global_hit = self._resolve_global_alias(norm_token, stripped_token)
        if global_hit is not None:
            return global_hit

        candidates = self._scoped_candidates_for_token(
            self.scoped_street_abbrs,
            norm_token,
            stripped_token,
        )
        if not candidates:
            return None
        return self._resolve_scoped_street(
            candidates,
            norm_token=norm_token,
            district_code=district_code,
            province_code=province_code,
            has_street_keyword=has_street_keyword,
        )
